other_repositories: Parser, CrisperBooks, libdbm, Filen, MadEdit, crisp-docx and storage-Rust audit heads are unchanged from the previous integration. Published-source/local-patch boundaries were retained.
fixes: Quote tmux refresh-client pane/action arguments so actual control-mode command parsing succeeds.
Accept paired tmux UINT_MAX saved-cursor sentinels only on the primary screen; continue rejecting missing alternate-screen saved coordinates. Two regression tests cover both cases.
Use a short private temporary directory for OpenSSH and real-agent fixture sockets to avoid macOS AF_UNIX path-length skips.
Preserve real tmux window names by protecting the POSIX control-character class inside a literal format; live coverage asserts a Unicode window label.
test_execution: Flutter invocations are serialized after an initial shared-native-output collision. Original failed attempts and direct tmux traces are retained separately; they are not pass evidence.

environment.ssh_server: macOS system OpenSSH, disposable high loopback ports
environment.ssh_agent: disposable ssh-agent loaded with an ephemeral test key

scope: Local integration and testing. No remote PR merge, push, deployment or change to system SSH server configuration.
